_readme: Allow-list for scripts/check-wiring.mjs (gate G4). An entry means a src/data value export is unreachable from any screen and is deliberately kept. Every entry must carry a real reason. The gate also fails on a stale entry (one that has become reachable), so the list cannot silently accumulate. Per docs/BRANCH-MAP.md the inert set in src/data/** is Builder B's to resolve; this branch builds the gate, records the finding, and does not build in another builder's scope (rule 5).
_builder-b: Builder B's per docs/BRANCH-MAP.md ('The export sits in src/data/** ... Builder B'). Recorded here so the gate can pass without this branch re-implementing B's resolution. The owner sees the list; it is not silent.
_a-own-unwired: This branch's own data export, built for a feature whose screen was not finished. Reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md as a wiring gap; wire it or hide the surface.

src/data/admin.ts::rightsOfRoleRow.reason: Maps a RoleRow to its rights map; the People admin reads role rights through a different path. Builder B's inert set per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/boardPack.ts::saveOrgSettingsEx.reason: Board-pack helper that writes org_settings_extra.last_board_meeting_date; the field is enforced by board_pack_generate (Phase 3.6) but this convenience wrapper has no caller. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/observations.ts::linkFinding.reason: Links an observation to a finding; promote_to_finding (0030) does this server-side. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/planning.ts::listDecisions.reason: Reader for suggestion decisions; the planning screen does not show them yet. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/population.ts::replaceLockedPop.reason: Replaces a locked population with a rationale; no screen offers it. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/secrets.ts::secretDisplay.reason: Reads a secret's masked display value; the secrets screen reveals through secret_reveal instead. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/writing.ts::listCellReviews.reason: Per-cell workbook review status (W2.9); the workbook UI does not surface it yet. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP (WK-* screens).

src/data/writing.ts::listPhrases.reason: Phrase-library reader; ReportBuilderPanel references a phrase type but not this reader. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/writing.ts::releasePhrase.reason: Platform-only phrase release once every cell is reviewed (W2.9); no screen offers it. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/writing.ts::reviewCell.reason: Marks one workbook cell reviewed (W2.9); no screen offers it. Builder B's per BRANCH-MAP.

src/data/systeligon.ts::recordSysteligon.reason: S13 writer that records a rule run's findings to the ledger (RPC systeligon_finding_record, 0118); the report side (loadSysteligonFindings, F39) is wired and green, but the rule-run screen that calls it is not built yet. Reported as a wiring gap; wire it or hide the surface.
